name: Rüthen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, red and white in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Rüthen (a black cross between red lozenges on white).
history: Municipal flag of Rüthen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Rüthen arms — cross and lozenges on white
